verses: Jab zamin poori tarah jhanjhor di jaye gi
Aur apney bojh bahir nikal phenkay gi
Insan kehney lagay ga kay ussay kiya hogaya?
Uss din zamin apni sab khabren biyan kerdey gi
Uss liye kay teray rab ney ussay hukum diya hoga
Uss roz log mukhtalif jamaten ho ker (wapis) loten gay takay unhen unn kay aemaal dikha diye jayen
Pus jiss ney zarra barabar neki ki hogi woh ussay dekh ley ga
Aur jiss ney zarra barabar buraee ki hogi woh ussay dekh ley ga
